challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I have reviewed the trade space for the upcoming model refresh. I am willing to accept that the model registry remains absent. In exchange, I require that the retraining pipeline becomes fully automated. This shift removes the manual bottleneck and allows us to iterate faster on weather features. The lack of a formal registry is a cost I am prepared to absorb. We gain speed and reduced operational overhead by letting the system handle the lifecycle without human intervention. This is the price I am willing to pay for a more agile deployment cycle. We will not build the registry if it blocks the automation of the retraining job.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept the absence of a model registry in exchange for a fully automated retraining pipeline, defining a specific cost they are prepared to absorb for the benefit of speed.
